name: Mountain Parallax Card
description: Photo destination card with a 3D tilt and glare on hover, layered depth parallax, a gold glowing frame, an elevation badge, location title and a call to action button.
contents: Full-bleed background photo card with glowing gold border
Elevation badge, location title with icon, destination subtitle
Call to action button with arrow icon
behavior: Card tilts toward the pointer with glare and slight scale using vanilla-tilt
Inner layers sit at different translateZ depths for a parallax feel
Card width is capped and scales down on small screens
editableByProps: Background image, all text, button label
Card width, aspect ratio and border glow color

needsCodeEdit.change: Change gold accent colors of badge, button and hover glow
needsCodeEdit.where: hover:shadow-[0_0_0_3px_rgba(255,214,102,0.6)...] class on the tilt card and the yellow classes on the badge and button

needsCodeEdit.change: Change glare strength or hover scale

needsCodeEdit.where: link element with id mountain-card-fonts and font-['Playfair_Display'] class on the h1

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Injects a Google Fonts link (Inter, Playfair Display) into document head once
